weather_forecast.section_desc: Short-range precipitation forecast (Open-Meteo) evaluated against regional intensity-duration threshold equations. Projections are forward guidance and do not overwrite authoritative current risk levels.
weather_forecast.disclaimer: Advisory forecast guidance only. Operational alerts require authoritative current computation.

response_prioritization.section_caption: Advisory decision-support ranking for disaster response teams. Combines risk severity (40%), population exposure (25%), road cutoffs (20%), and ground field reports (15%). Does NOT trigger automated dispatches.
response_prioritization.unranked_desc: Excluded from numerical ranking because risk severity is UNKNOWN due to telemetry outage. Requires ground assessment.

a11y.dialog_desc: LandAlert-Nexus is built to government portal standards (WCAG 2.1 AA target) to ensure disaster warnings are accessible to all operators and citizens.
a11y.visual_desc: Set in Atkinson Hyperlegible, a typeface designed for maximum legibility. Risk levels are conveyed through redundant indicators, never by color alone.
a11y.keyboard_desc: All interactive components—including the map, zone filters, alert triggers, forms, and dialogs—can be navigated using Tab, Enter, Space, and Esc.
a11y.screen_reader_desc: Critical system updates, emergency alert broadcasts, and network connection changes utilize aria-live polite regions to keep assistive technologies informed.
a11y.theme_desc: Supports OS-level dark/light mode preference by default, while allowing manual toggling without losing layout consistency or contrast ratios.
